title: Driver arriving soon
description: Alert customers that their driver is a few minutes away with name and vehicle. Utility WhatsApp template for last-mile delivery.
notes: Send when the driver is 10 to 15 minutes away. Driver name and vehicle info build trust.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, your driver {{driver}} is about {{minutes}} minutes away with your order. Look out for the vehicle: {{vehicle}}. Please be ready to receive it.
